paper.source_note: Written for this platform as a practice paper in the style of the S3 national examination. Not a NESA paper.

title: O-Level Mathematics — Sample Paper A
description: 75 minutes. Answer all questions. Section B answers are marked by your teacher — show your working.
subject: mathematics

questions.explanation: Add the indices when multiplying powers of the same base: $2^{3+4} = 2^7$.

questions.prompt: A right-angled triangle has shorter sides 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse (cm).
A bag holds 3 red and 5 blue balls. One is picked at random. What is the probability it is red?
Solve simultaneously: $x + y = 10$ and $x - y = 4$. Give the value of $x$.
Write down the exact value of $\sin 30^\circ$ as a decimal.
**Section B.** A rectangular garden is 3 m longer than it is wide. Its area is 40 m². Form an equation and solve it to find the length and width of the garden.
questions.marking_guide: M1: let width = w, length = w + 3. M1: w(w + 3) = 40 → w² + 3w − 40 = 0. M1: factorise (w + 8)(w − 5) = 0 or use formula. A1: w = 5 (reject −8 with reason). A1: length 8 m, width 5 m.
questions.explanation: $w(w+3) = 40 \Rightarrow (w+8)(w-5) = 0$, so the garden is 5 m by 8 m.

questions.prompt: **Section B.** In a class of 40 students, 25 study French, 20 study Kiswahili and 8 study both. Draw a Venn diagram and find how many students study neither language.
questions.marking_guide: B1: correct Venn diagram with 8 in intersection. B1: 17 French only and 12 Kiswahili only. M1: 17 + 8 + 12 = 37. A1: neither = 3.
questions.explanation: French only 17, both 8, Kiswahili only 12 → 37 study at least one, so 3 study neither.
